messages:
maya: :rotating_light: Heads up — we're seeing a routing drift in eu1 ingress that's leading to 5xxs for a small subset of hosted requests (long-context models). Started ~09:12 UTC. Investigating. Status: https://status.redwood.in/incident/2967890123

ops-bot: Alert fired: ingress-routing-anomaly.eu1 (alert_id=ingress-eu1-29678)

oncall-sre: I'm looking. Repro'd locally — traffic affinity to legacy-router-2 is sticky when concurrent connections > 180, causing connection resets. Collecting tcpdump and proxy logs.

liam: Starting traffic diversion to fallback-pool (eu1-fallback-routers) now. Command: `kubectl patch svc/ingress-router -n infra -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"pool":"fallback"}}}'`

eva: Applied temporary routing rule at 09:21 UTC. Expect error rate to drop within one batching window (~3m). Monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.in/d/ingress/eu1-routing

sofia: Preparing a short customer-facing note. Which customers hit hardest? @liam can you post top 5 customer IDs (anonymized) so comms can triage?

liam: top-impacts (anonymized): CUST-14, CUST-89, CUST-217. Notified account leads for those.

maya: Quick snapshot: 5xx rate peaked at 2.8% (09:18) across eu1, down to 0.4% after reroute (09:26). Tail latency still elevated for ~5% of requests. Root cause appears to be a control-plane affinity regression in router-manager introduced in yesterday's patch.

oncall-sre: Rolling hotfix to router-manager — restarting pods 1/3 then will monitor. Command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/router-manager -n infra`

ops-bot: Metric update: ingress.5xx_rate.eu1 — 09:18: 2.8% -> 09:30: 0.35%

liam: Took a conservative rollback option for the yesterday patch in staging, pushing same to eu1 if hotfix doesn't stabilize.

sofia: Customer bulletin sent (sent to affected accounts + status page updated). Draft: "We experienced intermittent 5xx errors in eu1 between 09:12-09:26 UTC due to internal routing drift. We implemented a temporary reroute; full fix in progress. See https://status.redwood.in/incident/2967890123 for updates."

maya: Current status: mitigated (reroute applied). Hotfix in progress to remove sticky affinity. ETA for full resolution: ~2 hours. Postmortem owner: liam. Runbook + notes: https://wiki.redwood.com/ingress/drift-runbook

oncall-sre: Hotfix rolling 2/3 -> 3/3 pods restarted. Observability shows connection resets dropping.

ops-bot: Incident annotation: severity=sev2, impacted_region=eu1, customer_impact=partial, start_ts=2967890123

maya: Closing update: error rate stable at ~0.2% for 15m, tail latency trending down. Marking incident as "Mitigated — monitoring" at 09:48 UTC. Will keep watch for 1 hour then move to resolved if no regressions. If anyone sees a spike, reopen thread or ping pager. :white_check_mark:
